_description: Multi-document scenario: two distinct materials in one ontology. Tests that both paths produce stable prompts when multiple papers (and corresponding entities) are processed in a single run.
_scenario_notes: Two fuel systems side-by-side: PWR UO2/Zry-4 and HTGR UCO/TRISO. Different entity types per paper, shared relation vocabulary.

entity_types.name: HTGR_TRISO

entity_types.name: HTGR_Compact
